rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=20, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-5 CG-CONVERGENCE lever (fd_recon_dc_n_cg 5->20), fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained breast val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: SSIM kept rising as prior influence dropped (0.712->0.814->0.894->0.909) BUT PSNR PLATEAUED at iter-3/4 (27.87/27.86 dB, RMSE 0.0138 both) despite init_t 0.4->0.2 -- so reducing prior influence no longer moves the RMSE-based headroom. The recon is pinned ~8.5 dB below the 128-view sparse-FBP floor (PSNR36.32/RMSE0.0052) by a NON-prior bottleneck. (2) Failure mode re-diagnosed: the hard CG DC-step uses only 5 inner iters warm-started at a poor (mis-scaled-prior) init; for a 128-view system that truncated CG cannot reach the least-squares solution the analytic FBP already achieves -> CG UNDER-CONVERGENCE now dominates, not prior influence. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_n_cg 5->20 (4x inner CG iters), from the best-SSIM-tier config (init_t0.4, relax1.0, NFE8); else = iter-3. (4) HYPOTHESIS: more CG iters drive min||Ax-y||^2 closer to the true LS recon, so PSNR/RMSE move toward the FBP floor and hr may clear 0; if PSNR stays ~28 dB, the DC solve is NOT the bottleneck either and the WDM-Mayo-prior recon is genuinely regime/domain-bounded below the sparse-breast FBP floor -> honest below-baseline finding, confirm toward iter-20. (5) BUDGET: 4x CG raises the per-Euler-step cost; iter-1 was fast (~<7min for 200 val) so 4x CG still fits 20 min, monitor wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-6 on landing.
